# Conspirators
[color=#999999][italic]"We are the chill wind on a winter's day. We are the shadow in the moonless night. We are the poison in your tea and the whisper in your ear. We are everywhere."[/italic][/color]
The Conspiracy are a group of crew members who collaborate to bring a sinister conspiracy to life. Conspirators are indifferentiable from crew members, but inherently know each other and are implanted with a [color=cyan]conspiracy radio implant[/color], allowing them to communicate with each other. Conspirators are a nonconversion group story/roleplay antagonist they cannot green text.
## Playing as a Conspirator
Conspiring is rather simple. - Check your character menu to see the identities of the other conspirators, as well as your [bold]objective[/bold]. If you have a different idea that you all agree on, you may ahelp and check with an admin if you can change your objective. - Use your radio implant [color=yellow][bold](:*)[/bold][/color] to communicate with your fellow conspirators. - Work together with the other conspirators to bring your dreams to life, potentially at the expense of the crew. - Remember to play as a responsible antagonist, antagonistic actions must serve your objective. Focus on ideas that will enhance others' experiences and create interesting stories.
